name: Temporary converter of parcellation/surface-deprecated datatypes to surface datatypes
summary: Converts the deprecated parcellation/surface datatype into the current surface/vertices and surface/data datatypes by copying and renaming files; a temporary format conversion utility.
description: Copies the left/right annotation files and label.json (and key.txt if present) into a surface/data output, and the inflated, pial and white surfaces into per-hemisphere folders of a surface/vertices output. No data are modified; use it only to migrate data created with the old datatype. Runs without a container.

inputs.description: Deprecated surface parcellation: lh/rh annotation, inflated, pial and white surfaces, key and label files.

outputs.description: left/ and right/ folders with the inflated, pial and white surfaces (<hemi>.<surface>.gii).
left.gii and right.gii parcellation data with label.json and key.txt.
